Guides for a smoother start.

Useful information about subscriptions, Android players and reseller setup.

Guides for a smoother start.Omar · Editorial pen name

Choosing a ProMax IPTV subscription

Begin with the device you plan to use and the number of connections you need. The available plans run from one to 24 months, with one connection per plan. A shorter plan offers flexibility; a longer plan reduces how often you need to renew. Before paying, ask support to confirm content availability, picture quality, setup instructions and any separate player app fee.

Once your plan is confirmed, save the activation details and renewal date in a secure place. That makes later support requests and renewals easier.

Guides for a smoother start.Layla · Editorial pen name

How to set up a compatible Android player

Android players can use different login methods. Some use a MAC address and portal; others use a username and password. Install a player that matches the credentials you receive. Check that you trust the download source and that your device supports the app.

Enter the credentials exactly as supplied. If playback does not start, verify the device connection and contact support before changing portal or MAC settings.

Guides for a smoother start.Sari · Editorial pen name

Understanding reseller credits

A reseller credit represents a 12-month service period under the stated pack rule. Starting with 10 credits helps you learn the panel workflow before committing to a larger volume. The 20, 50 and 100-credit packs suit businesses with more customers or renewals.

Before ordering, confirm the price, credit expiry, panel access, sub-reseller options and the server covered by the pack. Keep a simple record of each line and its renewal date.

Guides for a smoother start.Andrew · Editorial pen name

What to check before renewing a line

Before renewing a customer line, check its expiry date and confirm the customer still uses a compatible device and player. Review available credits in your panel, then ask support if any package terms have changed.

After renewal, verify the new service period in the panel and share the updated access details securely with the customer.
